Gap Description: Initial Medical Assessment by attending physician lacks a dedicated clinical intake form with provisional diagnosis, investigation plan, and 24-hour completion validation.
Current EMR State: Doctor assessment is partially recorded inside RMO Handover Tab as a narrative clinical summary.
NABH Mandate: NABH AAC.3.a mandates documented initial medical assessment within 24 hours of admission for all inpatients.
Recommended Remediation: Implement a structured Doctor Initial Medical Assessment form with provisional diagnosis, examination, investigation plan, and 24h timer.
Acceptance Criteria: Form accessible in Patient Assessment; validates completion timestamp within 24 hours of admission; requires physician signature.

Gap Description: No single consolidated, printable Discharge Summary document generating all AAC.7 required sections (final diagnosis, treatment summary, physical findings, post-discharge medication advice, urgent contact).
Current EMR State: Discharge instructions exist in Daycare tab and Med Reconciliation tab, but no unified printable inpatient discharge summary exists.
NABH Mandate: NABH AAC.7.b requires a comprehensive discharge summary provided to patient at time of discharge.
Recommended Remediation: Create a consolidated Discharge Summary Generator compiling doctor orders, diagnosis, med reconciliation, and follow-up advice.
Acceptance Criteria: One-click discharge summary report generation with digital signatures of treating consultant and resident.

Gap Description: Code Blue cardiac arrest resuscitation workflow lacks precise electronic response time logger (Target < 3 minutes) and CPR team log.
Current EMR State: General emergency alerts exist in Hospital Home banner, but no dedicated Code Blue resuscitation record form is available.
NABH Mandate: NABH COP.5.b mandates monitoring of resuscitation response times and CPR team composition.
Recommended Remediation: Add Code Blue Event Logger tracking announcement time, arrival time, response duration, CPR team leader, defibrillation shock count, and outcome (ROSC/Expired).
Acceptance Criteria: Response time auto-calculated; flags breach if > 180 seconds; generates monthly resuscitation audit summary.

Gap Description: Pre-operative checklist exists, but intra-operative WHO 3-Phase Surgical Safety Checklist (Sign-In, Time-Out, Sign-Out) lacks dedicated time-stamped digital form.
Current EMR State: PreOpChecklistTab covers ward-level pre-op preparation before transferring to OT.
NABH Mandate: NABH COP.14.c mandates implementation of WHO Surgical Safety Checklist in the Operating Room.
Recommended Remediation: Add intra-op Surgical Safety Checklist modal with Sign-In (before induction), Time-Out (before incision), and Sign-Out (before leaving OT).
Acceptance Criteria: Checklist requires surgeon, anaesthetist, and circulating nurse confirmations before incision timestamp is recorded.

Gap Description: Biomedical waste segregation information is disclosed to patients at admission, but hospital lacks a daily weighing and barcoded bag dispatch register in the EMR.
Current EMR State: Disclosed on patient counselling form ASH/COU/1 FLD022.
NABH Mandate: NABH HIC.8 mandates compliance with Bio-Medical Waste Management Rules 2016 (daily color-coded weight logging).
Recommended Remediation: Add BMW Daily Register recording weights for Yellow, Red, White, and Blue categories with CBWTF barcoded manifest number.
Acceptance Criteria: Daily waste generation dashboard with color-coded breakdown and monthly CPCB return generator.

Gap Description: Patient feedback and complaints workflow currently operates through paper/verbal mechanisms without a digital grievance logging and TAT tracker in EMR.
Current EMR State: Grievance handling mechanism brochure is handed over on admission (ASH/COU/1).
NABH Mandate: NABH PRE.5 mandates an established mechanism for registering, investigating, and redressing patient complaints.
Recommended Remediation: Build a Patient Feedback & Grievance Register tracking complaint category, investigating officer, root-cause, CAPA, and closure TAT.
Acceptance Criteria: Ability to log grievances, track resolution within 72 hours, and calculate KPI #9 automatically.

Gap Description: Field modifications in localStorage are saved without an immutable append-only audit trail logging user ID, workstation, and before/after values.
Current EMR State: Records store createdAt and nurseName, but edits do not preserve full version history or view logs.
NABH Mandate: NABH IMS.3.b requires complete confidentiality, data integrity, and immutable audit trails for medical record modifications.
Recommended Remediation: Implement an append-only audit log capturing every record creation, view, edit, and deletion with digital timestamp and user role.
Acceptance Criteria: Every update generates an audit entry; audit logs are viewable by Quality / Admin but tamper-proof.
